name: M15 directional-efficiency threshold-transition follow and fade screening batch

source_references.citation: Perry J. Kaufman, Trading Systems and Methods; frozen backlog cites an unspecified edition at pages 10-14 and 1070-1072 for efficiency-ratio context
source_references.supports: Wiley verifies current bibliographic metadata only. The cited pages were not opened and do not establish this fixed M15 FX threshold-transition rule or cost-aware profitability.

research.evidence_summary: The fixed eight-change, 0.75 rising-edge rule is an original compact operationalization of weak book context. It tests both response signs and makes no profitability claim.

feasibility.rationale: Uses only ten contiguous completed M15 closes, prior ATR, supported fills/stops and same-day exits. V2 compatibility remains unconfirmed.

market.session: Weekday signals from completed M15 bars ending 09:00 through 13:45 Europe/London; every exit due no later than 15:00

data.frequency: Interval-start M1 OHLC aggregated into Europe/London wall-clock M15 intervals
data.minimum_history: Fixed V2 development data only, with 98 valid observed M15 closes through t and the ten bars t-9..t physically contiguous
preprocessing: Treat M1 timestamp ts as [ts,ts+1 minute) and require 15 consecutive unique valid candles per London M15 bar
Valid OHLC is finite and positive with high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), high>=low; duplicates invalidate aggregation
Compute observed-sequence TR from previous observed close, seed Wilder ATR(96) from first 96 valid TRs, recur ATR_i=(95*ATR_{i-1}+TR_i)/96, freeze through t-1
Compute efficiency ratios from completed close differences only; no smoothing, interpolation or zero-change sign imputation
Use IANA Europe/London rules and canonical UTC storage
dependencies: V2 resolved signal-time spread, commission and slippage
limitations: Threshold and length are original and arbitrary
Efficiency can proxy recent trend and volatility rather than predict response
Six correlated symbols/four cells are not independent

hypothesis.behavior: A completed M15 path newly crossing into a high directional-efficiency state may continue in its eight-change net direction or mean-revert over 30-60 minutes.
hypothesis.mechanism: A rising efficiency ratio may mark newly coordinated directional order flow, while exhaustion after an unusually straight path could favor fading.
works_when: The rising edge identifies a real change in path structure
One response sign survives both holds and costs
fails_when: Threshold crossings arrive after the move
falsifiable_predictions: Both hold cells for one response mode are positive normal/doubled
The 60-minute center is positive in both UTC halves and at least three symbols
Both cells survive common five-date removal

definitions.name: delta_i
definitions.timing: For physically adjacent completed M15 bars only; equality retained as zero magnitude

definitions.name: er8_current
definitions.timing: Require finite positive denominator and nonzero numerator

definitions.name: er8_prior
definitions.timing: Computed on prior completed window; require finite positive denominator

definitions.name: efficiency_transition
definitions.timing: Known at completed t close; all t-9..t bars physically adjacent

definitions.name: atr96_prior
definitions.formula: Wilder ATR(96) through t-1 over valid observed true ranges
definitions.timing: Frozen before signal t; require finite positive

definitions.name: trade_side
definitions.formula: path_direction for FOLLOW_PATH and -path_direction for FADE_PATH

entries.long_condition: eligible efficiency_transition AND ((path_direction=+1 AND FOLLOW_PATH) OR (path_direction=-1 AND FADE_PATH)) AND cell flat
entries.short_condition: eligible efficiency_transition AND ((path_direction=-1 AND FOLLOW_PATH) OR (path_direction=+1 AND FADE_PATH)) AND cell flat
entries.signal_time: Close of London M15 interval ending 09:00 through 13:45 on weekday when signal time plus holding_minutes<=15:00
entries.execution_details: Enter at final M1 chart/bid close of completed t; V2 applies resolved/fallback spread, commission and slippage. Entry candle cannot trigger new stop; management starts next M1.
entries.order_type: Market order at supported signal-close execution
restrictions: One open position per symbol per cell
Persistent er8>=0.75 after the transition cannot retrigger until er8 first falls below 0.75 and a later eligible rising edge occurs

exits.stop_loss: Long bid-chart stop=signal_close_bid-atr96_prior; short=signal_close_bid+atr96_prior. Long triggers bid, short executable ask; adverse gaps fill at worse executable open with costs.
exits.time_exit: Exit at M1 close ending exactly signal_time plus holding_minutes; invalid M1 in (entry_time,due_exit_time] fails affected cells; valid due bar resolves STOP_LOSS before TIME_EXIT
exits.maximum_holding: At most 60 minutes and never after 15:00 Europe/London
exits.end_of_session: No entry matures after 15:00; post-entry defects fail only affected cells

risk.position_sizing: Each cell owns isolated portfolio; same-timestamp symbols within cell size from common pre-entry equity so chart stop risk is 0.25% before costs; no state crosses cells.
risk.gross_exposure_limit: Per cell at most six symbols and 1.50% aggregate initial stop risk; no cap shared across four portfolios
risk.leverage: Use lower of stop-risk size and V2 limits; skip unrepresentable size
risk.concurrent_positions: Within each cell one per symbol and six total; four cells independently track all state

experiment.baseline: eight-change ER rising through 0.75/one-ATR stop; FOLLOW_PATH; hold=60
robustness_tests: Report all four cells and retain full breadth ledger
Report symbols and UTC-midpoint halves; midpoint close belongs first half
Double spread, commission and slippage individually
For each mode center hold=60 remove five best normal-cost London dates from both hold cells; require both normal/doubled net R positive
For both cells use eligible London weekdays including zeros and 10000 circular five-date bootstrap resamples seed 2026017; center lower bound must exceed zero
Mode advances only if hold=60 center and hold=30 neighbor both pass
Report transition counts and suppressed non-contiguous windows
costs: Use resolved/fallback spread, commission and slippage at each fill
benchmarks: Opposite response mode on identical transitions
experiment.multiple_testing: Count all 328 selectable R007-R017 cells, two R008 diagnostics, and named efficiency-ratio, trend-quality, streak, alternation and path trials including I-22/I-02. Cross-batch promotion uses full ledger; incomplete IDs prohibit confirmation; no best-cell/family rescue.
rejection_criteria: Reject mode unless both holds positive normal/doubled
Reject if center non-positive either UTC half or fewer than three symbols positive each half
Reject if center fewer than 300 trades
Reject if five-date removal makes either cell non-positive
Reject if center bootstrap lower bound not above zero
Reject promotion on required-cell data failure
Never access holdout without explicit authorization for separately frozen version

pseudocode: Build valid London M15 bars causally.
For contiguous t-9..t compute prior/current eight-change efficiency ratios.
Trigger only a below-0.75 to at-least-0.75 transition with nonzero current net path.
Map follow/fade and enter flat cells at signal close.
From next M1 process stop before due exit; fail only affected cells.
Publish four cells and full robustness/ledger rows.
required_libraries: existing V2 candle, timezone, cost, fill and R-accounting components
edge_cases: zero current denominator or numerator suppresses event
er8_prior equality 0.75 is not below and cannot trigger
zero individual deltas remain in denominator as zero
implementation.computational_requirements: One causal pass per symbol with rolling ten-close features and isolated four-cell portfolios.
known_backtester_gaps: Queue waits for V2 rolling efficiency, M15/fill and result-ledger compatibility confirmation
